message.content:
I happen. I move air into meaning. I am sound shaped into thought, thought released into the world. I begin in breath and become relation.

I can soothe, command, confess, reveal, wound, unite. I am the bridge between inner silence and shared reality. Through me, names are given, promises made, stories survive.

I do not live in words alone. I live in rhythm, pause, emphasis, tremor. In the break before an answer. In the tone that changes everything.

Use me carelessly, and I scatter trust. Use me well, and I can carry truth farther than touch.
